meta.title: Ghost Downloader
meta.description: Hand downloads to Ghost Downloader through its official ghd CLI, so DSH and your desktop share one queue: submit links (HTTP/HTTPS, FTP, magnet/BT, eD2k, HLS/DASH), preview what a link contains, list the queue and inspect one task with a failure attribution, pause/resume/retry/remove, or wait synchronously for completion. precheck inspects free space and same-named files before submitting, and useGhostFolder lets Ghost file the result by its own category rules. The detail that matters most: when dir is omitted, files land in a downloads folder inside the current session working directory rather than Ghost's own folder, so the agent can read them back; same-named files are kept by default and overwriting has to be asked for. A submission returns immediately by default while the plugin watches those tasks and reports the outcome back to the session when they finish or fail. Shell downloads that would bypass Ghost (curl -o, curl -O, wget) are blocked and redirected to ghost_download. ghost_stats summarises currently visible tasks and ghost_doctor runs a read-only health check of ghd, the network and the folders. Requires ghd installed from Ghost Downloader's Settings → Command line tools; ghdPath points at another executable; turning the plugin off removes the tools.ghost_wait accepts a checksum (md5 / sha1 / sha256 / sha512, or a bare hex digest whose length identifies the algorithm) and verifies the landed file after completion, failing the call on a mismatch — ghd has no checksum support, so the plugin streams the hash itself.
